summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026, reporting its unaudited operating results for May 2026. The disclosure covers consolidated revenue of NT$19.52 billion for the month and NT$100.01 billion for the five months ended May 31, 2026, along with income from operations, net income, EBITDA, and earnings per share. The filing also includes routine items on sales volume, fund lending, endorsements, guarantees, and derivative transactions. This is a standard periodic earnings release, not a special-situation event. There are no terms such as a price per share, premium, or strategic transaction. What to watch: none; this is a routine operating update with no event-driven angle.
